name: Wonderland Yde
description: An indoor and outdoor family entertainment complex located along the new Bastos road. It includes arcade lounges, a modern kids' playground, trampoline zones, a small roller rink, bicycle tracks, and swimming pools.
bonASavoir: This park focuses primarily on kids and teenagers. Entrance fees vary by duration: expect to pay 4,000 FCFA per child for mid-day access or 7,000 FCFA for a full-day pass. On-site meals and drinks are considered expensive by visitors.
